get.description: Read-only manager dashboard. Package visits from GSI3 (VENDOR#{vendorId}#DATE#{date}); one-time bookings from vendor GSI1 BOOKING#{date}# range with planId excluded. GSI2 is not used. date defaults to today in the vendor IANA timezone; upcomingDays default 3 (1-7). UNSCHEDULED excluded; CANCELLED excluded from total; blocked is persisted BLOCKED only. Completion % uses today.visits.total. Does not include proposals or profile greetings.

parameters.name: vendorId
parameters.description: Vendor id. Must match the caller's owner membership, or the caller must be a platform admin.

parameters.name: date
parameters.description: Civil date YYYY-MM-DD. Defaults to today in the resolved vendor timezone.
